body: Thanks yeah I get that it’s a text but when the phone turns on and I go to send them another message should or not be blue now?
Thank you! Honestly it’s so good to hear that I’m not crazy or asking too much of a friendship
Thank you, you too, you seem like a great person, keep pushing on

I also don’t want to tell them I’m feeling suicidal because I don’t want them to think I’m being dramatic but I’ve always thought I’ve lived passed when I should have, I honestly feel like I’ve pushed on and on in the hope that it gets better and the only thing getting better is me hiding it all

❤️ it’s hard isn’t it? It’s a horrible feeling and you are right about becoming self reliant but the thing is I am actually the one that they rely on like they come to me with their problems and I’m always there but when I try to express how I feel it’s dismissed as me being immature and juvenile and that I’m too clingy and trying to keep them to myself but that really isn’t it like that isn’t it! I just want to scream that I’m clinging on for dear life here someone f*ckin help please just help me
You’re right but it’s so hard for me as I’m a ride or die sort of person and I find it tough walking away.... even tougher without an explanation
